title: Manifest resolver
hints: expand_includes is a depth-first search. Write an inner visit(name) function that appends to an outer `order` list, then recurses over manifests[name].get("included_manifests") or [].

You need two different sets: `done` (already fully visited: return early, this is how a diamond is handled) and the current recursion `path` (a list or set: if the name is already on it, that is a cycle). Push before recursing, pop after.
The cycle message: path[path.index(current):] + [current] joined with " -> ". Check the cycle before the done check, or a self-include is silently accepted.

resolve_manifest: get order, collect, conflicts = sorted(set(installs) & set(uninstalls)), then filter both lists with a comprehension against set(conflicts). missing is sorted({i for i in installs + uninstalls if i not in set(catalog)}) only when catalog is not None.
